SELECT s.School,
       s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS FullAddress
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT f.CDSCode,
       f.`School Name`,
       f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_num_test_takers
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sc.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'

SELECT sc.School AS school_name, sc.MailStreet AS postal_street
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS students_ages_5_to_17
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT AdmEmail1 AS email
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = '62'
  AND DOC = '54'
  AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT AdmEmail2
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = '62'
  AND DOC = '54'
  AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = '62'
  AND DOC = '54'
  AND AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL

WITH fem AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A11, c.birth_date
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN disp p ON p.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
oldest AS (
    SELECT * FROM fem
    WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM fem)
),
low AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS low_sal FROM oldest
)
SELECT o.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - l.low_sal AS gap
FROM oldest o
JOIN low l ON o.A11 = l.low_sal

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  )

SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ds ON ds.account_id = a.account_id AND ds.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = ds.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Monterey' AND f.`School Type` LIKE '%High%' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`School Name`, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, CAST(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_frpm_rate FROM frpm f INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC = '66' AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet, sc.AvgScrMath FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND s.City = 'Fremont' AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT School, AdmFName1, AdmLName1, AdmEmail1, AdmFName2, AdmLName2, AdmEmail2, AdmFName3, AdmLName3, AdmEmail3 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino' AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND SOC = '62' AND DOC = '54' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
SELECT MIN(A11) AS lowest_avg_salary, MAX(A11) AS highest_avg_salary FROM district

SELECT l.account_id, l.amount, a.date FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND l.status IN ('A', 'C') AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993' AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(l2.amount) FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id WHERE l2.duration > 12 AND l2.status IN ('A', 'C') AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT a.account_id, c.client_id, a.frequency FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp di ON di.account_id = a.account_id AND di.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = di.client_id WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND strftime('%Y', a.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'
